protocol Shape {
    func area() -> Int
}

class Rectangle: Shape {
    let width: Int
    let height: Int

    init(width: Int, height: Int) {
        if width > 0 && height > 0 {
            self.width = width
            self.height = height
        } else {
            self.width = 0
            self.height = 0
        }
    }

    func area() -> Int {
        return width * height
    }

    func classify(score: Int) -> Int {
        guard score > 0 else { return 0 }
        if score > 90 {
            return 3
        } else if score > 50 {
            return 2
        }
        return 1
    }

    func pick(a: Int, b: Int, c: Int) -> Int {
        switch a {
        case 1:
            return b
        case 2:
            return c
        default:
            return a
        }
    }

    func loop(n: Int) -> Int {
        var total = 0
        for i in 0..<n {
            if i % 2 == 0 || i % 3 == 0 {
                total += i
            }
        }
        while total > 100 && n > 0 {
            total -= n
        }
        return total
    }
}
